headline: A quiet day with no new scored events
body: No new events were scored today. Every ending moved by less than 0.1 point as the effect of earlier announcements slowly faded, a routine drift of about 0.01 for several lines. Horizon Balance held at 0.83. Nothing changed in the underlying world factors.
movers_note: No ending moved by 0.1 or more; the largest changes were drifts of -0.01 (Benevolent Dictator, Protector God, Gatekeeper, Enslaved God) from fading older news.
